career_overview.short_description: Design, provision, and maintain scalable, reliable cloud infrastructure and services across virtual networks, compute, and storage.
responsibilities: Architect and provision resilient cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
Configure secure virtual private clouds (VPCs), subnets, routing tables, and gateways
Deploy and scale compute workloads using virtual machines, containers, and serverless functions
Manage cloud storage lifecycle policies, relational and NoSQL databases, and CDNs
Implement automated monitoring, resource alarms, backup policies, and disaster recovery
representative_work: A production-grade multi-tier cloud infrastructure provisioned entirely with Terraform, featuring public/private VPC subnets, an auto-scaling compute cluster behind an Application Load Balancer, a managed database, and automated CloudWatch alarms.
core_skills: Virtual Private Clouds (VPC) and CIDR subnets
Compute instances, auto-scaling, and load balancing
Managed relational and NoSQL database services
DNS management, routing, and CDN distribution
Cloud monitoring, metrics, and automated alerting
High availability and disaster recovery planning

roadmap.title: Cloud Engineer: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor, terminal and modern browser. Most tasks use free software or local runtimes.
roadmap.final_outcome: A production-grade multi-tier cloud infrastructure provisioned entirely with Terraform, featuring public/private VPC subnets, an auto-scaling compute cluster behind an Application Load Balancer, a managed database, and automated CloudWatch alarms.
